facts.text: The user asked whether the INSPIRE Initiative from the Appalachian Regional Commission is familiar to the assistant.
The user asked about a Letter of Intent (LOI) to Apply for INSPIRE Funding.
The user requested an example of a properly formatted and effectual Letter of Intent (LOI) to Apply for INSPIRE Funding via the partnership with the Ohio Governor’s Office of Appalachia.
